decisions.reason: As a recent launch close to the core marking portfolio, the printer still has option value under uncertainty and likely shares technologies, channels and service resources that make carrying it relatively inexpensive.
The software module directly supports the firm’s strategic push toward digitalization and traceability and is cheap to maintain relative to hardware, so management would usually preserve this option.
This coder extends the established offer to additional surface types, and without evidence of poor market acceptance the firm is likely to keep the product while demand uncertainty resolves.
